categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor interfaces in src/script/descriptor.h specifically intended to support wallet and GUI wallet key validation flows.
categories.rationale: Exposes standalone descriptor key expression parsing and derivation path inspection needed by the GUI multisig setup wizard. As noted in the description, external callers like the GUI wizard currently cannot validate pasted key expressions without wrapping them in dummy descriptors; merging this unblocks tracking issue #35645.
